name: regina_inquiry_conversion
cadence_note: Monthly waves of 15-20. Refuses dossier.why_no_book='went_elsewhere' (those guests are done).
description: Re-engage past_guest_inquired contacts whose dossier identifies a specific addressable blocker (price, dates_unavailable, no_response).
prompt_context: This guest inquired but didn't book — the dossier names the reason. Address the specific blocker (price, dates, response time) without being defensive. Offer a concrete path forward (revised quote, alternate dates, faster reply). Keep under 130 words. Sign as Sarah.
